description: Test the second 20-union difference band in the shared feed-forward input map
proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,704 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 28 prior macro-attempts and 406 prior micro-trials in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0085/micro-0020 at 1,704 parameters and 99.01%; the most recent failed result remains attempt-0081/micro-0007, whose token-matrix union scored 98.97%. The first FF-input band in attempt-0084 retained all 20 unions. Hypothesis: feature-construction redundancy extends into the next, larger-difference band, and continuing ascending current group difference for one fixed band will reveal its boundary while leaving QKV and FF-output groups unchanged. This parameterization-preserving compression is more informative than immediately taking a second FF-output band because its next untested difference scale is higher and therefore provides a stronger sensitivity test. Each micro-trial adds one FF-input union and the official runner alone accepts or rolls back. Stop on the first scored discard or error, at 20 micro-trials, or if no pair remains. Compute budget: at most 20 checkpoint migrations and official verifications or 30 wall-clock minutes.
summary: The second FF-input band stopped on its first micro-trial. Unioning the next closest FF-input groups proposed 1,703 parameters but scored 3.82%, so it was discarded and rolled back; the frontier remained 1,704 parameters at 99.01%. Outcomes: 0 accepts, 1 scored discard, 0 errors. Compute used one checkpoint migration and one official verification over 1m32s wall clock. Stop reason: the first scored failure closed this larger-difference FF-input path before the 20-trial/30-minute cap.
